tie_rule: Non-finals playoff MATCH tied: Table 10-3, in order: 1st cumulative MAJOR FOUL points due to opponent rule violations; 2nd ALLIANCE AUTO FUEL points; 3rd ALLIANCE TOWER points; 4th MATCH is replayed (§10.6.2.1, p.128). Finals: a tied Finals MATCH remains a tie; up to 3 Overtime MATCHES; a tied Overtime MATCH is decided by Table 10-3 (§10.6.2.2, p.128). Einstein Finals: a tied MATCH is replayed (§13.4, p.148). No 2026 Team Update changed Table 10-3.
